title: Growth config: LOYALTY_RULES
description: Loyalty points rules (GRW-P4-D): points per COMPLETED booking, tiers from completed-booking counts in a rolling window, FIFO expiry, an annual cap and the conversion into a reward lot of kind LOYALTY. Money relevant: two-person rule and an announcement. EVERY amount and tier threshold defaults to 0 and 0 means switched off (a tier with minCompletedBookings 0 is never reached; conversion with pointsRequired 0 or valueMinor 0 is closed; an annual cap of 0 refuses accrual). Points are not money: there is no cash, top-up or transfer setting. Unknown keys rejected. Added in the unreleased set. PROPOSED_DEFAULT until ratified (counsel, NH 11 and 18, and finance).

enabled.description: Master switch of the rule set (the launch-locked flag growth.loyalty still decides whether anything runs).

pointsPerCompletedBooking.description: Points added when a booking reaches COMPLETED (never on a hold, a deposit or a confirmation). 0 = no accrual.

windowMonths.description: Rolling window over which completed bookings count towards a tier. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 12.

expiryMonths.description: Months a point lives; the oldest points are used and expire first (FIFO). PROPOSED_DEFAULT 12.

annualCapPoints.description: Most points one person can earn in a rolling 365 days (accrual and tier bonus). 0 refuses accrual until the founder sets one.

pointsRequired.description: Points spent for one conversion block. 0 closes conversion.

valueMinor.description: Minor units of the reward lot one block becomes. 0 closes conversion. It is a promotional coupon or credit lot of the existing reward ledger (REWARD_RULES caps still apply), never cash.

maxBlocksPerYear.description: Blocks one person can convert in a rolling 365 days. 0 closes conversion.

minCompletedBookings.description: Completed bookings in the window needed to reach the tier. 0 = the tier is not defined (nobody reaches it).

bonusPoints.description: Points granted once per rolling year when the tier is first reached.
